summary: An ATV rolled onto its rider while crossing a narrow rock-lined gully in the foothills west of Villa Grove; the companion drove 10 miles to Villa Grove to find a phone. SAR reached the site by UTV and on foot, packaged the patient on a backboard, and transported by UTV/pickup to a landing zone about 1.5 miles away where Reach Air Medical was requested for the severe injuries.
notes: Source: Saguache County SAR Facebook page.
